howIntro: Two ways we put money into a picture.

sides.name: Equity
sides.text: We invest in pictures from producers we've vetted. Before we commit, we work with you to pre-sell distribution rights, so contracts cover as much of the budget as possible. We take a share of what the film earns from there.

sides.name: Structured finance
sides.text: The less glamorous side, and the part that gets everyone paid. We lend against your tax credits, your signed sales contracts and your unsold territories, and we bridge you to bank financing that's on its way.

criteriaIntro: If the people behind a project aren't reliable, or don't understand the financing, we pass. Every project gets the same six questions.

criteria.name: Marketability
criteria.text: Is there a clear audience and a way to reach it?

criteria.name: Team
criteria.text: Have the producer and director delivered before?

criteria.name: Talent
criteria.text: Does the cast move the needle with buyers?

criteria.name: Distribution
criteria.text: Is there a credible path to sales, presales, or a platform?

criteria.name: Revenue
criteria.text: Do the projections hold up when we push on them?

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.text: Where does our money sit and what secures it?

investorsLead: Film investing has been a closed room.
investorsIntro: Most people never get offered a seat. We offer one, in film and in live entertainment, with the risk worked down before your money goes in.

investors.name: Access
investors.text: We pool capital into professionally managed funds, so you get into deals you wouldn't see alone, on better terms than you'd get alone.

investors.name: Less risk
investors.text: Every film investment carries risk. We reduce it the way any careful investor would: vetted producers, distribution sold before the shoot, and loans secured by contracts and tax credits.

investors.name: Two ways to earn
investors.text: Equity gives you a share of what a picture earns. Lending earns interest along the way. We do both, so the fund isn't riding on one hit.

investors.name: Being there
investors.text: Festivals, premieres and award nights for the pictures you helped make, and time with the directors, the producers and the cast. People pay for that. For our investors it comes with the investment.
